mapper.insert: INSERT INTO app.daily_store_sales ( sales_date, store_code, order_count, line_count, total_quantity, total_amount, created_at ) SELECT order_date, store_code, COUNT(DISTINCT order_no), COUNT(*), SUM(quantity), SUM(amount), now() FROM app.order_detail WHERE order_date = #{targetDate} GROUP BY order_date, store_code
